summary: Iteration 4 backend + frontend regression + new features: 65/65 pytest tests PASS (46 existing + 19 new). All 3 new features are green. (1) SIGNATURE: POST /api/temperatures and POST /api/cleaning attach immutable signature block {user_id, user_name, org_id, control_type, signed_at, status, comment}; signature is preserved on offline-idempotent re-POST (same client_id returns identical signature). (2) CORRECTION+AUDIT: POST /api/controls/{ctype}/{cid}/correct works for temperatures & cleaning as responsable, returns audit_id, sets corrected=true + corrected_by_name on the record, GET /api/controls/{ctype}/{cid}/audit returns full history with old_values+new_values+reason+changed_by. Verified guards: employe=>403, invalid ctype=>400, missing reason=>422, empty reason=>422, all-protected-fields=>400, unknown cid=>404, cross-org=>404. Protected fields (id, org_id, created_by, created_by_name, created_at, signature) are stripped. (3) DOSSIER PDF: GET /api/export/dossier returns %PDF-1.4 with default sections, with date_from/date_to, with a subset of sections, employe=>403, company-isolated (org A dossier does not contain org B unique supplier names). Full existing suites (auth, receptions, batches, temperatures, cleaning, NC, losses, search, archives, PDF, users, subscribe, files, dashboard, statistics, reminders config/pending, CSV export, company isolation, offline idempotency) all still pass. Frontend on 390x844 mobile viewport: /reminders shows 'Notifications mobiles' card with 'Mobile requis' pill on web preview + manager can toggle temperature times / cleaning time / add custom control and Save (persists, 'Enregistré ✓' shown); /temperature list items show 'Contrôle effectué par Jean Dupont — 16/08/2026 à 21:24' + CORRIGER button per row (19 records verified); /correct screen opens with fields+mandatory reason+audit history section, correction persists (Chambre A visibly updated from 6.0°C -> 3.2°C after submit + '⚠ Corrigé par Jean Dupont' flag added); /cleaning shows signature lines too (9 records); /dossier has date range inputs + 6 section checkboxes (temperatures, cleaning, non_conformities, receptions, traceability, losses) + Générer button; Settings tab exposes goto-reminders and goto-dossier buttons. No red screens. Local OS notification delivery not testable on web preview - only permission/status UI verified (correctly shows 'Mobile requis' on web).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (already reported iter 1 & 3). Non-blocking - originates from a 3rd-party lib (react-native-gesture-handler / svg / gifted-charts), not app code.

Warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' Expected on web preview; behavior is correctly gated by Platform.OS === 'web' in /app/frontend/app/reminders.tsx (shows 'Mobile requis' pill and hides schedule count). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, carry-over) Migrate props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents where possible, or bump 3rd-party libs (gesture-handler/svg/gifted-charts).
(Optional) server.py is now 1291 lines. Consider splitting into routers (auth, controls, exports, reminders) for maintainability.

(Optional) Rate-limit / auth-token the GET /api/export/dossier URL: the frontend opens it via window.open(url), but api.dossierUrl() must embed the Bearer token as a query param or use a short-lived download token to work in browsers where Authorization header cannot be attached to window.open. If this is already handled inside api.dossierUrl (session cookie or ?token=), OK; if not, PDF may 401 on real user click. Please verify.
(Optional) On the correct.tsx screen, the success message auto-navigates back after 1200ms — consider extending to 1800ms or requiring an explicit dismiss so the confirmation is more visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1094 PROTECTED_FIELDS correctly guards id/org_id/created_by/created_by_name/created_at/signature; verified at API level by test_protected_fields_rejected.
server.py:1104 correct_control scopes lookup by org_id — cross-org attack returns 404 (verified by test_cross_org_correct_404).

server.py:222 create_doc attaches signature ONLY when control_type is passed; temperatures/cleaning wired correctly (lines 587, 599). Other controls (receptions, NC, losses) intentionally do NOT get a signature block — matches PRD which limits signature to temperature & cleaning.
server.py:1160 export_dossier filters every collection by org_id via _date_range_query — company isolation confirmed by test_dossier_company_isolated.
correct.tsx submits reason.trim() only; empty/whitespace reason is blocked client-side AND rejected server-side (422) — defense in depth OK.

reminders.tsx correctly no-ops notification permission logic on web (isWeb branch) and shows 'Mobile requis' pill. Native rescheduleReminders is called after successful save so no duplicates (cancel-all-then-reschedule pattern in /app/frontend/src/notifications.ts).
Immutability caveat: nothing prevents a direct DB write; endpoint-level guard (PROTECTED_FIELDS) is the sole enforcement, which is acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical iteration-4 flows verified (reminders save + Mobile requis pill, temperature signature + CORRIGER, correct.tsx submit + audit list, cleaning signature, dossier screen with date range + 6 sections, settings entry points)

Correction endpoint accepts ANY of the 5 collections (temperatures/cleaning/non_conformities/receptions/losses) but only the first two show CORRIGER in the UI today (temperature.tsx and cleaning.tsx). Dossier PDF sections list accepted: temperatures, cleaning, non_conformities, receptions, losses. If not implemented, either remove the checkbox or add the section server-side. Local OS notification scheduling can only be tested on a real device / Expo Go build; the offline flush (NetInfo) is still web-untestable.
